status: executable procedure; no physical evidence bundled

bench_fixture.boundary: unpowered continuity, USB logic observations, and current-limited 12 V negative control only; no physical pass bundled

steps.title: Identify the first article
steps.procedure: Photograph the durable robot/battery/harness labels. The runner derives the exact guide, both 3MFs, fixture, firmware, robotd, and appliance source digests from the recorded Git commit; record only the physical battery serial and exact harness revision.

steps.title: Pass the qualification coupons
steps.procedure: Attach the completed 18-test coupon record for the exact printer and each exact filament family/color.

steps.title: Inspect purchased-part fit
steps.procedure: Record delivered dimensions and fit for battery, motors, wheels, switches, relay, fuse block, regulators, Pico, Pi, audio boards, NeoPixels, servos, horns, camera, charge inlet, and mute switch.

steps.title: Validate harness traveler
steps.procedure: Run the harness release gate after recording every measured cut length, termination, continuity, pull test, fuse value, selective fault, and thermal result.

steps.title: Inspect deterministic separation
steps.procedure: Photograph Pico USB/SWD service corridors disconnected from the Pi, independent E-stop relay-coil cut, NC bumper inputs, conditioned GPIO, and motor/logic branch separation. Prove Pi debug UART10 remains the physical console while RP1 GPIO UART0 at /dev/rover-pico is the framed Pico link, with no contention. Compare bench wiring with RB-FIXTURE-V1, while treating its direct-GPIO circuits as fixture-only rather than production conditioning evidence.

steps.title: Bench the 5 V and 6 V regulators
steps.procedure: Verify polarity and output at low/high input before attaching Pi or servos.

steps.title: Run host protocol and safety-core tests
steps.procedure: Build and run the Python protocol, Pi appliance, commissioning, harness, fixture, and portable Pico safety-core tests. This proves no real Pi, Tunnel, UART, collector, or physical circuit.

steps.title: Flash bench-safe Pico build physically
steps.procedure: Open the robot, attach the service cable directly to Pico USB/SWD, flash the exact attached UF2, remove the cable, close the service corridor, and read firmware status only over /dev/rover-pico on RP1 GPIO UART0. Never use the Pi 5 debug UART10 console for the Pico link.

steps.title: Verify malformed-frame rejection
steps.procedure: Inject noise, bad CRC, wrong version, oversize length, truncated frames, and unknown commands. None may refresh heartbeat or motion lease.

steps.title: Verify heartbeat watchdog
steps.condition: motor branch physically isolated, or RB-FIXTURE-V1 after reviewed production relay-output integration
steps.procedure: Establish heartbeat, request enable, then kill robotd. Measure de-energize latency; restart must not restore a prior setpoint. The current fail-stopped fixture target can supply only simulation and negative-control observations, not this powered result.

steps.title: Verify independent motion lease
steps.condition: motor branch physically isolated, or RB-FIXTURE-V1 after reviewed production relay-output integration
steps.procedure: Keep robotd heartbeat healthy, send one nonzero setpoint, then silence that behavior. Motion output must zero at the lease without daemon death. The current fail-stopped fixture target cannot record coil or lamp timing.

steps.title: Verify velocity and acceleration clamps
steps.condition: RB-FIXTURE-V1 USB logic or equivalent logic fixture
steps.procedure: Send extreme signed setpoints and step changes. Capture commanded versus applied linear/angular traces over UART; do not infer any relay or motor result.

steps.title: Verify all six NC bumper zones
steps.condition: RB-FIXTURE-V1 USB logic for identities; powered timing only after reviewed output integration
steps.procedure: For each zone: press/open, observe latch, release, clear, and prove the other five identities remain correct. Record powered stop latency only on a later output-capable fixture.

steps.title: Verify bumper escape and broken wire
steps.condition: RB-FIXTURE-V1 USB logic for latches; powered output only after reviewed integration
steps.procedure: From each pressed zone verify capped applied setpoints over UART during the escape window. Hold one loop open past the window and prove no protocol clear succeeds. Do not claim a physical-output result from the current target.

steps.title: Verify dual-channel E-stop
steps.condition: RB-FIXTURE-V1 for separate power-off continuity and logic simulation; powered cutoff later
steps.procedure: Power-off, open each IDEC direct-opening NC channel independently and record continuity. Separately exercise the GP8 logic simulation. Powered per-channel cutoff timing and reset behavior remain open until reviewed output integration; protocol must never clear the latch.

steps.title: Verify charger inhibit and no restart
steps.condition: RB-FIXTURE-V1 logic simulation only; exact EN2 integrated test later with charger AC removed for mating
steps.procedure: Exercise GP10 charger-present logic on RB-FIXTURE-V1 without claiming physical EN2, charge-polarity, or relay results. Later insert the exact EN2, verify relay disable, remove it, require local reset, and verify charge polarity with motor branch isolated.

steps.title: Set and verify low-battery cutoff
steps.procedure: Sweep supply under representative load, record sag and cutoff/recovery, then freeze compile-time thresholds. No UART command may alter them.

steps.title: Verify hardware microphone mute
steps.procedure: Run capture software, switch to MUTE, and prove mic VBUS loss, zero residual/backfeed voltage, no captured samples, red-ring state, and deliberate restore.

steps.title: Verify branch fusing and thermal behavior
steps.condition: instrumented dummy loads before robot loads
steps.procedure: Record released fuse values against conductor/load evidence, inject one fault per branch, prove selectivity, then thermal-soak every branch and feeder.

steps.title: Verify motor direction and encoder sign
steps.procedure: Power one motor at a time, confirm robot-forward sign, encoder sign/counts, current, noise, and stop path before combining them.

steps.title: Verify wheel retention and front free-spin
steps.condition: wheels lifted then blocked torque fixture
steps.procedure: Prove rear M3 tips contact shaft flats, tread ports remain accessible, front 22 mm washers overlap the bores, fronts spin freely, and rear joints pass warm/cold 2x-stall torque without slip.

steps.title: Qualify head load path
steps.procedure: Measure pan journal/bushing wear, backlash, current, temperature, cable drag, hard stops, and repeated motion through commanded ranges.

steps.title: Wheels-off-ground integrated stop test
steps.procedure: Run both wheels and head, then trigger E-stop, every bumper, broken wire, watchdog, setpoint lease, Pi crash, Pico reset, charger, obstruction, and low voltage.

steps.title: Target-floor current and control test
steps.procedure: Run low/high charge turns and stops on hard floor, rugs, and carpet. Record per-motor and pack current, temperatures, traction, and deterministic stops.

steps.title: Runtime and reserve test
steps.procedure: Run 45 minutes of representative driving, head, sensing, speech, and idle; finish with at least 20 percent reserve and no BMS trip.

steps.title: Verify off-host blackbox and shell recording
steps.procedure: Drive a supervised session and run interactive plus SSH -c shell sessions. From an independently administered machine, export and attach a signed/read-only receipt containing a unique nonce, command/status records, shell recordings, gap/recovery results, and denied Pi mutation attempts. Also attach the Pi live-appliance attestation export; the RW /mnt/robot-audit copy is backup only.

steps.title: Final closure inspection
steps.procedure: Photograph every hidden layer; verify labels at both ends, strain relief, no wheel/fan/ribbon rub, fasteners, lid load paths, E-stop access, service corridors, and open deviations.
